meta.selection_strategy: Sequential: take ads in the exact order the 'รถมาใหม่วันนี้' (fno:new) page shows them (newest first), walking the result list page by page (10 per page, the size the site's own infinite scroll uses) until MAX_ADS (<=100) ads are collected or the results run out. Ads already in raw_ads.jsonl count toward MAX_ADS and are not fetched again.
meta.iqa_method: MUSIQ (pyiqa 'musiq', KonIQ-10k weights, runs locally); quality_score = MUSIQ (0-100) / 10
meta.view_method: CLIP zero-shot (local open_clip), mean embedding of the prompts per class

exterior: a photo of the whole exterior of a car

interior: a photo of a car interior with seats and dashboard
a photo of a car steering wheel, dashboard or seats from inside
engine: a photo of a car engine bay with the hood open
detail: a close-up photo of a car wheel, tire, headlight or badge
a close-up photo of one small part of a car
other: a photo of a document, sticker, registration book or car keys
a photo of a paper form or a tax sticker on a windshield

เก๋ง: a photo of a sedan car
a photo of a small hatchback car

กระบะ: a photo of a pickup truck
